study_design: Case-control analysis within the Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging using plasma selenium measured before prostate cancer diagnosis.
reason: The abstract analyzes later development of prostate cancer overall and does not define or analyze an aggressive incident subtype.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared with the lowest quartile of selenium (range 8.2 to 10.7 microg./dl.), the odds ratios of the second (10.8 to 11.8), third (11.9 to 13.2) and fourth (13.3 to 18.2) quartiles were 0.15 (95% confidence interval 0.05 to 0.50), 0.21 (0.07 to 0.68) and 0.24 (0.08 to 0.77, respectively, p =0.01).
estimate_classifications.reason: The highest-versus-lowest quartile estimate concerns overall prostate cancer development, not aggressive disease.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
